append-empty-a4-page-to-pdf.title: Append Empty A4 Page to PDF
append-empty-a4-page-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, add a new blank A4‑sized page at the end of the document, and save the updated file.

insert-blank-page-at-index-three.title: Insert Blank Page at Specific Position in PDF
insert-blank-page-at-index-three.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, insert a new blank page at the third position, and save the modified document.

insert-page-matching-page2-size.title: Insert Page with Same Size as Page 2 at Position 5
insert-page-matching-page2-size.description: Loads a PDF, reads the width and height of page 2, inserts a new blank page at position 5, and sets the new page's dimensions to match page 2 before saving the document.

add-multiple-empty-pages-to-pdf.title: Add Multiple Empty Pages Sequentially to PDF
add-multiple-empty-pages-to-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate over a list of page counts, add the specified number of blank pages, and save the updated document.

read-pdf-page-dimensions.title: Read PDF Page Dimensions with Aspose.Pdf
read-pdf-page-dimensions.description: Loads a PDF file, iterates through each page, and logs the page width and height (in points) to the console.

resize-pdf-page-to-letter-size.title: Resize PDF Page to Letter Size
resize-pdf-page-to-letter-size.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it has at least seven pages, and changes page 7 to US Letter dimensions using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-pdf-pages-to-a5.title: Resize All PDF Pages to A5 Size
resize-pdf-pages-to-a5.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, loop through each page, set the page dimensions to A5 (420 × 595 points), and save the modified document.

rotate-fourth-page-90-degrees-clockwise.title: Rotate Fourth PDF Page by 90 Degrees
rotate-fourth-page-90-degrees-clockwise.description: Loads a PDF, verifies it has at least four pages, rotates page 4 clockwise by 90 degrees, and saves the modified document.

convert-odd-pages-landscape-to-portrait.title: Convert Odd Pages from Landscape to Portrait
convert-odd-pages-landscape-to-portrait.description: Shows how to reorient odd‑numbered PDF pages by swapping the width and height of their MediaBox using Aspose.Pdf.

move-page-9-to-first-position.title: Move Page 9 to First Position in PDF
move-page-9-to-first-position.description: Shows how to relocate a specific page (page 9) to the beginning of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf's page collection operations.

reorder-pdf-pages-custom-sequence.title: Reorder PDF Pages Using Aspose.Pdf
reorder-pdf-pages-custom-sequence.description: Demonstrates how to reorder pages of an existing PDF by copying them into a new document according to a custom integer array.

delete-last-three-pages-from-pdf.title: Delete Last Three Pages from PDF
delete-last-three-pages-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, remove the last three pages using PageCollection.Delete, and save the modified document.

insert-custom-sized-page-at-beginning.title: Insert Empty Page with Custom Size at PDF Start
insert-custom-sized-page-at-beginning.description: Demonstrates how to add a new blank page with specific dimensions (200 × 300 points) at the beginning of an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

append-page-to-pdf.title: Append a Page from One PDF to Another
append-page-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates loading two PDF files and appending a page from the source PDF to the end of the target PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

duplicate-third-page-in-pdf.title: Duplicate PDF Page and Insert After Original
duplicate-third-page-in-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, creates a deep copy of page 3 using a temporary Document, inserts the copied page immediately after the original page, and saves the modified PDF.

convert-pdf-pages-portrait-to-landscape.title: Convert PDF Pages from Portrait to Landscape
convert-pdf-pages-portrait-to-landscape.description: Shows how to change each PDF page to landscape orientation by swapping the MediaBox width and height using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-blank-pages-after-each-page.title: Insert Blank Page After Each PDF Page
insert-blank-pages-after-each-page.description: Shows how to double a PDF's page count by inserting a blank page after every existing page using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-pdf-pages-by-parity.title: Rotate PDF Pages Based on Page Number Parity
rotate-pdf-pages-by-parity.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, rotates odd‑numbered pages 90° while leaving even pages unchanged, and saves the modified document.

export-pdf-page-dimensions-to-csv.title: Export PDF Page Dimensions to CSV
export-pdf-page-dimensions-to-csv.description: Loads a PDF document, reads each page's width and height in points, converts the values to inches, and writes the dimensions to a CSV file for external analysis.

insert-page-from-another-pdf.title: Insert Page from Another PDF at Specific Position
insert-page-from-another-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to copy a page from a source PDF and insert it into a target PDF at a given index while keeping the original page size and rotation.

set-custom-size-first-pdf-page.title: Resize First PDF Page to Custom Dimensions
set-custom-size-first-pdf-page.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, set the first page size to 500 × 700 points, and save the modified document.

rotate-pdf-pages-reverse-order.title: Rotate PDF Pages in Reverse Order
rotate-pdf-pages-reverse-order.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterating its pages from last to first, rotating each page 90 degrees clockwise, and saving the result.

move-pdf-pages-to-end.title: Move Pages 3‑6 to End of PDF
move-pdf-pages-to-end.description: Shows how to relocate a range of pages (pages 3 to 6) to the end of a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf in C#.

copy-mediabox-page-8-to-12.title: Copy MediaBox from Page 8 to Page 12
copy-mediabox-page-8-to-12.description: Demonstrates how to retrieve the MediaBox rectangle from one PDF page and apply it to another page using Aspose.Pdf, ensuring both pages share the same dimensions.

insert-ten-empty-pages-at-pdf-midpoint.title: Insert Ten Blank Pages at PDF Midpoint
insert-ten-empty-pages-at-pdf-midpoint.description: Demonstrates how to calculate the middle of a PDF and batch‑insert ten empty pages at that position using Aspose.Pdf.

resize-wide-pdf-pages-to-a4.title: Resize Wide PDF Pages to A4
resize-wide-pdf-pages-to-a4.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through its pages, and changes any page whose width exceeds 600 points to A4 dimensions, leaving narrower pages unchanged.

delete-pdf-pages-from-config.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
delete-pdf-pages-from-config.description: Shows how to read page numbers from an external configuration file and delete those pages from a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

reorder-pdf-pages-descending.title: Reorder PDF Pages in Descending Order
reorder-pdf-pages-descending.description: Shows how to reorder the pages of a PDF in descending numeric order using Aspose.Pdf by creating a sorted index list and copying pages to a new document.

convert-pdf-pages-to-portrait.title: Convert PDF Pages to Portrait Orientation
convert-pdf-pages-to-portrait.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, and swaps the MediaBox dimensions for landscape pages so that all pages become portrait before saving the document.

rotate-every-third-pdf-page-90-degrees.title: Rotate Every Third PDF Page by 90 Degrees
rotate-every-third-pdf-page-90-degrees.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, rotate pages whose number is divisible by three by 90 degrees, and save the modified document.

delete-first-page-from-pdf.title: Remove First Page from PDF
delete-first-page-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, delete its first page, and save the modified document.

resize-pdf-pages-uniform-size.title: Resize PDF Pages to Uniform Size
resize-pdf-pages-uniform-size.description: Demonstrates how to scan a PDF for the largest page dimensions and then resize all pages to that width and height, producing a uniform‑sized document.

reset-page-rotation.title: Restore PDF Page Rotation
reset-page-rotation.description: Demonstrates how to reset a previously rotated PDF page to its original orientation using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-resize-reinsert-pdf-pages.title: Extract, Resize, and Reinsert PDF Pages
extract-resize-reinsert-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to extract a range of pages from a PDF, change each page to A4 size, and insert the modified pages at a new position using Aspose.Pdf.

move-even-pages-to-end.title: Reorder PDF Pages: Move Even Pages to End
move-even-pages-to-end.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, reorder its pages by placing all odd‑numbered pages first and then the even‑numbered pages, and save the result.

resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size.title: Resize PDF Pages to Match Template Size
resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size.description: Shows how to resize every page of a PDF to the width and height of a template PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-pdf-pages-using-config.title: Rotate PDF Pages by Configurable Angles
rotate-pdf-pages-using-config.description: Demonstrates rotating individual PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf by reading rotation angles from a dictionary and applying the corresponding Rotation enum.

insert-transparent-separator-page.title: Add Transparent Separator Page to PDF
insert-transparent-separator-page.description: Shows how to insert an empty page with a transparent background into an existing PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-last-page-from-pdfs.title: Delete Last Page from PDFs in a Folder
delete-last-page-from-pdfs.description: Shows how to loop through PDF files in a directory, remove the last page of each document using Aspose.Pdf, and overwrite the original files.

move-pdf-page-to-another-document.title: Move PDF Page Between Documents Preserving Rotation
move-pdf-page-to-another-document.description: Demonstrates how to transfer a single page from one PDF file to another while keeping its original rotation, size, and other attributes using Aspose.Pdf.

crop-pdf-page-media-box.title: Set Custom MediaBox to Crop PDF Page
crop-pdf-page-media-box.description: Demonstrates how to change a page's MediaBox in Aspose.Pdf to define a custom cropping region without altering the page content.

batch-resize-pdf-pages-fixed-width.title: Batch Resize PDF Pages to Fixed Width
batch-resize-pdf-pages-fixed-width.description: Shows how to resize every page in a PDF to a target width of 800 points while maintaining the original aspect ratio using Aspose.Pdf.

delete-specified-pdf-pages.title: Delete Specific Pages from PDF Using Aspose.Pdf
delete-specified-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to read page numbers from a text file and remove those pages from a PDF document with Aspose.Pdf.

reorder-pdf-pages-by-orientation.title: Reorder PDF Pages by Orientation
reorder-pdf-pages-by-orientation.description: Shows how to load a PDF, separate landscape and portrait pages, and create a new PDF with all landscape pages first followed by portrait pages.

resize-pdf-pages-to-printable-area.title: Resize PDF Pages to Fit Printable Area
resize-pdf-pages-to-printable-area.description: Shows how to proportionally scale each page of a PDF to fit within a target printable area (A4 size) and center it using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-empty-page-with-custom-size.title: Insert Custom-Sized Empty Page into PDF
insert-empty-page-with-custom-size.description: Shows how to prompt the user for page dimensions and add an empty page of that custom size to an existing PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-to-first-pdf-page.title: Add Text Header to First PDF Page Using MarginInfo
add-header-to-first-pdf-page.description: Demonstrates how to configure page margins and place a styled text fragment as a header on the first page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-html-header-to-first-three-pdf-pages.title: Add HTML Header with CSS to First Three PDF Pages
add-html-header-to-first-three-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to insert an HTML fragment containing CSS‑styled header text into the first three pages of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-footer-with-scaling-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Scaled Footer Image to PDF Pages
add-image-footer-with-scaling-to-pdf-pag.description: Shows how to insert a footer image on every page of a PDF, scaling it to 50% of the page width and centering it at the bottom using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Image Footer with Opacity to PDF Pages
add-image-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add an image footer with 30% opacity to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-generation-date-footer-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Generation Date Footer to PDF Pages
add-generation-date-footer-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a TextFragment containing the current date, add it as a footer to each page, and save the modified document.

add-rotated-image-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Rotated Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-rotated-image-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a semi‑transparent image watermark, rotated 45°, scaled to half the page size and centered on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-image-watermark-with-opacity-to-pdf-.title: Add Image Watermark with 20% Opacity to PDF Pages
add-image-watermark-with-opacity-to-pdf-.description: Demonstrates how to overlay a semi‑transparent PNG image as a watermark on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-repeating-image-watermark-to-pdf-pag.title: Add Repeating Image Watermark to PDF Pages
add-repeating-image-watermark-to-pdf-pag.description: Shows how to load an image, convert its size to PDF points, and stamp it repeatedly in a grid pattern on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-year-text-watermark-to-pdf.title: Add Yearly Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-year-text-watermark-to-pdf.description: Shows how to create a text watermark that includes the current year and apply it to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-curved-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Curved Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-curved-text-watermark-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to place a watermark that follows a cubic Bézier curve across each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.title: Add Semi-Transparent Text Watermark to PDF Pages
add-semi-transparent-text-watermark.description: Shows how to open a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, create a semi‑transparent TextStamp, configure its font and color, apply it to each page as a watermark, and save the modified document.

add-lightgray-background-to-pdf-pages.title: Add LightGray Background to All PDF Pages
add-lightgray-background-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to apply a LightGray background color to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf for consistent branding.

set-transparent-background-for-pdf-pages.title: Set PDF Page Background to Transparent
set-transparent-background-for-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, set each page's background color to transparent, and save the modified document.

set-pdf-page-background-cmyk.title: Set PDF Page Background Color Using CMYK Values
set-pdf-page-background-cmyk.description: Demonstrates loading a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, creating a CMYK color, applying it as the background for each page, and saving the modified document.

add-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Centered Page Numbers to PDF
add-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to add a centered page‑number stamp to each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-roman-numeral-page-numbers.title: Add Roman Numeral Page Numbers to PDF
add-roman-numeral-page-numbers.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, convert page indices to Roman numerals, and insert them as centered page numbers on the introductory pages.

add-chapter-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Insert Chapter‑Prefixed Page Numbers into PDF
add-chapter-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and add a custom "Chapter X" page number at the bottom center of each page before saving the result.

insert-page-numbers-leading-zeros.title: Insert Page Numbers with Leading Zeros in PDF
insert-page-numbers-leading-zeros.description: Shows how to add sequential page numbers to each page of a PDF, formatting single‑digit numbers with a leading zero, using Aspose.Pdf.

add-custom-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Insert Custom Page Numbers into PDF
add-custom-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Shows how to add a "Page X of Y" footer to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

insert-custom-page-numbers-pdf.title: Add Page Numbers with Custom Separator to PDF
insert-custom-page-numbers-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and insert a page‑number string formatted as "current/total" at the bottom‑right of each page using Aspose.Pdf.

add-superscript-page-numbers-to-pdf.title: Add Superscript Footnote Page Numbers to PDF
add-superscript-page-numbers-to-pdf.description: Loads a PDF, iterates through each page, and inserts a superscript‑styled page number as a footnote positioned near the bottom‑right corner, then saves the modified document.

insert-page-numbers-arial-font.title: Add Page Numbers with Arial Font to PDF
insert-page-numbers-arial-font.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, iterate through its pages, and insert sequential page numbers using the Arial font at a custom position, then save the updated document.

add-page-numbers-with-custom-embedded-fo.title: Insert Page Numbers with Custom Embedded Font
add-page-numbers-with-custom-embedded-fo.description: Demonstrates how to add page numbers to each PDF page using a TrueType font loaded from an external .ttf file and saved with Aspose.Pdf.

add-page-numbers-to-odd-pdf-pages.title: Add Page Numbers to Odd PDF Pages
add-page-numbers-to-odd-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and add a page number text fragment only on odd-numbered pages before saving the document.

add-page-numbers-to-even-pdf-pages.title: Add Page Numbers to Even PDF Pages
add-page-numbers-to-even-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and insert page numbers only on even-numbered pages before saving the result.

add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Bates Numbering Stamp to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert a Bates numbering stamp that starts at 1000 with a dash separator on every page of a PDF and save the result using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bates-numbering-with-custom-prefix-s.title: Add Bates Numbering with Custom Prefix and Suffix to PDF
add-bates-numbering-with-custom-prefix-s.description: Demonstrates how to apply Bates numbering to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp with a custom prefix "DOC" and suffix "-2026".

add-bates-numbering-with-prefix.title: Add Bates Numbering with Prefix to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-with-prefix.description: Shows how to load a PDF, iterate over its pages, and apply an alphanumeric Bates number stamp (e.g., PRJ-0001) to each page using Aspose.Pdf.

batch-add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.title: Batch Bates Numbering for PDF Pages
batch-add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages.description: Demonstrates how to add Bates numbers to each page of multiple PDFs, incrementing the number by 5 and saving the stamped documents to an output folder.

remove-bates-numbering-add-new-sequence.title: Update Bates Numbering in a PDF
remove-bates-numbering-add-new-sequence.description: The example loads a PDF, removes any existing stamp annotations used for Bates numbers, and adds a new sequential Bates number stamp to each page.

remove-bates-numbering-from-selected-pdf.title: Remove Specific Bates Number Stamp from PDF Pages
remove-bates-numbering-from-selected-pdf.description: Shows how to locate and delete a Bates numbering StampAnnotation from selected PDF pages using Aspose.Pdf.

replace-pdf-headers-footers.title: Replace PDF Headers and Footers
replace-pdf-headers-footers.description: Loads a PDF, removes any existing header/footer on each page, and adds new header and footer content with custom text and fonts. The modified document is then saved to a new file.

read-pdf-page-count.title: Read Total Page Count from PDF
read-pdf-page-count.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and retrieve the total number of pages without saving the document.

adjust-pdf-bleedbox-for-printer-specs.title: Adjust BleedBox for Printer Bleed in PDF
adjust-pdf-bleedbox-for-printer-specs.description: Loads a PDF, expands each page's BleedBox by a 5 mm margin (converted to points) to meet printer bleed requirements, and saves the modified document.

retrieve-trimbox-after-cropping-pdf-page.title: Retrieve TrimBox After Cropping a PDF Page
retrieve-trimbox-after-cropping-pdf-page.description: Shows how to crop a PDF page using the CropBox and then read the resulting TrimBox values with Aspose.Pdf.

crop-pdf-pages-remove-margins.title: Crop PDF Pages to Remove Margins
crop-pdf-pages-remove-margins.description: Shows how to set the CropBox of each PDF page using rectangle coordinates to trim off page margins.

extend-bleedbox-beyond-cropbox.title: Extend BleedBox Beyond CropBox in PDF
extend-bleedbox-beyond-cropbox.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, read each page's CropBox, create a BleedBox that extends 5 points on all sides, assign it to the page, and save the updated document.

trim-white-space-from-pdf-pages.title: Trim PDF Pages Using Aspose.Pdf Trim Method with Dynamic Fallback
trim-white-space-from-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to load a PDF, attempt to trim white‑space from each page using Aspose.Pdf's Trim() method via dynamic invocation, handle missing method gracefully, and save the result.

trim-white-margins-pixel-tolerance.title: Trim PDF Pages with Custom Pixel Tolerance
trim-white-margins-pixel-tolerance.description: Demonstrates how to trim white space from each PDF page by adjusting the MediaBox and CropBox using a per‑page pixel tolerance.

crop-pdf-pages-to-4-3-aspect-ratio.title: Crop PDF Pages to 4:3 Aspect Ratio
crop-pdf-pages-to-4-3-aspect-ratio.description: Shows how to adjust each page's CropBox to achieve a fixed 4:3 aspect ratio for presentation slides using Aspose.Pdf.

add-header-logo-image-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Header Logo to PDF Pages
add-header-logo-image-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to insert a left‑aligned logo image as a header on every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bold-uppercase-header-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Bold Header to Each PDF Page
add-bold-uppercase-header-to-pdf-pages.description: Shows how to open a PDF, loop through all pages, and insert a bold uppercase header near the top of each page using Aspose.Pdf.

rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees__v2.title: Rotate All PDF Pages 180 Degrees
rotate-all-pdf-pages-180-degrees__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, rotate each page by 180 degrees, and save the modified document.

resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size__v2.title: Resize PDF Pages to Match a Template
resize-pdf-pages-to-template-size__v2.description: Shows how to resize every page of a PDF to the width and height of a reference PDF template using Aspose.Pdf.

add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages__v2.title: Add Bates Numbering to PDF Pages
add-bates-numbering-to-pdf-pages__v2.description: Shows how to insert year‑based Bates numbers (e.g., 2026‑0001) on each page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf's TextStamp.

read-pdf-page-dimensions__v2.title: Read PDF Page Dimensions
read-pdf-page-dimensions__v2.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, and log each page's width and height in points.

set-pdf-page-background-color.title: Set PDF Page Background Color Using RGB
set-pdf-page-background-color.description: Demonstrates how to apply a corporate brand RGB background color to every page of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-page-background-color-hsl.title: Set PDF Page Background Color Using HSL
set-page-background-color-hsl.description: Shows how to convert HSL values to RGB, apply the resulting Aspose.Pdf.Color as the background for each page of a PDF, and save the modified document.

set-pdf-page-background-color-from-theme.title: Apply Theme-Based Background Color to PDF Pages
set-pdf-page-background-color-from-theme.description: Reads a theme name from a configuration file, maps it to a color, and sets that color as the background for each page in a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-alternating-page-background-colors.title: Set Alternating Page Background Colors in PDF
set-alternating-page-background-colors.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, iterate through its pages, assign LightGray or White as the background color on alternating pages, and save the modified document.

insert-page-numbers-after-toc.title: Insert Page Numbers After Table of Contents Using Bookmark Detection
insert-page-numbers-after-toc.description: Demonstrates how to locate a "Table of Contents" bookmark in a PDF, determine its page, and add sequential page numbers to all subsequent pages.
